mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8% and FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer confidence and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 increases for 2 consecutive quarters.
